# Separate authoring, reuse and native operation costs

Date: 2026-09-13. Status: scoped experiment; no product boundary changes.

Historical total tokens contain substantial repeated cached input and cannot
predict whether another world will be cheaper. A matched small-world experiment
therefore uses the actual player-selected Astra/xhigh author and normal native
tools, with independent profiles and retained repairs.

Reference source is published/imported through the existing Rust catalog and
world factory. Operators may confirm installation, check, adopt and exercise
ordinary physics, but cannot write model-authored source or move a player by
teleportation. Runtime save/reopen is measured independently from source storage.

The result separates model-turn/tool time from host startup, operator stages,
reference preparation and idle scheduling gaps. Direct template creation is a
zero-model route; adding a fresh Agent's inspection is an additional measured
stage, not mislabelled generation work. Frozen package hashes and original failed
records prevent a later fix from rewriting the historical comparison.
